# RxPepsDirect

> RxPepsDirect is a telehealth platform that prescribes pharmaceutical-grade
> compounded peptides through Optimal Balance Pharmacy, a 503A-licensed
> compounding pharmacy. One flat $39 medical visit fee covers up to 3
> peptides per order. The pharmacy bills patients directly at wholesale,
> RxPepsDirect takes no markup on medication. Licensed in 28
> states (including the District of Columbia). Every compounded batch is independently tested by
> Eagle Analytical Services for sterility (ScanRDI) and bacterial endotoxin
> (USP <85>), and every report is published. Operated by Peptide RX LLC.
> Medical Director: Dr. Jonathan Snipes, MD (NPI 1821250077). Lead
> Prescriber: Kim Callender, NP (FNP-BC, NPI 1144661760).

Pricing model: $39 flat visit fee per order. No subscription, no
membership, no auto-renewal. Up to 3 peptides per visit. The pharmacy
charges separately at wholesale cost. Patients pay only when they reorder.

Coverage: 28 states (including the District of Columbia). Telehealth provider licensing varies
by state. Eligibility is checked during intake.

These are starting prices from Optimal Balance Pharmacy at compounding
wholesale. Add the $39 flat RxPepsDirect visit fee at
checkout. No subscription, no markup on medication.

## Therapeutic categories

- [Weight Loss & Metabolic](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss): GLP-1 receptor agonists and metabolic peptides that support healthy weight management through proven mechanisms. Includes Semaglutide/B12, Semaglutide/B6 + Glycine, Tirzepatide/B12, Tirzepatide/B6 + Glycine, Ondansetron 4mg ODT.
- [Muscle Growth & Body Composition](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/muscle-growth): Growth hormone secretagogues and anabolic support peptides for lean muscle development and body recomposition. Includes CJC-1295/Ipamorelin, Sermorelin, Sermorelin/Ipamorelin, Tesamorelin, Tesamorelin High-Dose.
- [Recovery & Repair](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/recovery-repair): Tissue repair peptides and healing factors that accelerate recovery from injury, surgery, and inflammation. Includes BPC-157, Wolverine Stack, BPC-157/TB-500/KPV, KLOW, BPC-157 Capsules.
- [Longevity & Anti-Aging](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/longevity): Cellular rejuvenation peptides that target the fundamental mechanisms of aging at the mitochondrial and telomeric level. Includes NAD+ Injectable, NAD+ Nasal Spray, Epithalon, Epithalon High-Dose, GHK-Cu.
- [Cognitive & Brain Health](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/cognitive): Nootropic peptides and brain-health compounds for focus, memory, neuroprotection, and cognitive performance. Includes Dihexa, DSIP, Semax/Selank Nasal Spray, Methylene Blue 5mg, Methylene Blue 10mg.
- [Sexual Health & Vitality](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/sexual-health): Peptides and compounds that support libido, arousal, and intimate connection through natural hormonal pathways. Includes PT-141, PT-141 Nasal Spray, Kisspeptin, Oxytocin Troche 50IU, Oxytocin Troche 120IU.
- [Immune Optimization](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/immune): Immune-modulating peptides that enhance your body's natural defense and recovery systems. Includes Thymosin Alpha-1, ARA-290, KPV.
- [Skin & Hair](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/topical): Compounded topical creams, serums, and scalp solutions at 1-3% active concentration (30 to 60 times higher than mass-market OTC peptide skincare). Provider-prescribed by RxPepsDirect; filled at wholesale by Optimal Balance Pharmacy. Includes GHK-Cu 1% Hair Restoration Solution, Cashmere Cream, GHK-Cu Biocosmetic Cream, GHK-Cu Biocosmetic + SNAP-8 Cream, GHK-Cu SNAP-8 Niacinamide Serum.

## Browse by delivery format

- [Injectable Peptides](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/format/injectable): Subcutaneous injection peptides shipped pre-reconstituted from Optimal Balance Pharmacy. Includes GLP-1s, GH secretagogues, recovery peptides, and longevity stacks.
- [Oral Peptides](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/format/oral): Capsule, troche, and orally disintegrating tablet formulations. Avoids needles for patients who prefer an oral or sublingual route.
- [Topical Peptides](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/format/topical): Creams, serums, and scalp solutions applied directly to skin or scalp. Compounded at 1 to 3 percent active concentration; 30 to 60 times the strength of mass-market OTC peptide skincare.
- [Nasal Spray Peptides](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/format/nasal): Intranasal spray formulations for peptides where mucous-membrane absorption matters. Short BUDs (30 days); fast onset.

## Featured peptide protocols

- [Semaglutide/B12](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss/semaglutide-b12): The gold standard GLP-1 for weight management, paired with B12 for energy support. _From $25/1.2mg_
- [Semaglutide/B6 + Glycine](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss/semaglutide-glycine): Glycine-buffered semaglutide for patients who don't tolerate the B12 cofactor. _From $175/10mg_
- [Tirzepatide/B12](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss/tirzepatide-b12): Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist for enhanced metabolic support with B12. _From $45/12mg_
- [Tirzepatide/B6 + Glycine](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss/tirzepatide-glycine): Glycine-buffered tirzepatide for patients who don't tolerate the B12 cofactor. _From $225/60mg_
- [CJC-1295/Ipamorelin](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/muscle-growth/cjc-ipamorelin): The gold standard growth hormone secretagogue stack for lean muscle and recovery. _$100/10mg+10mg_
- [BPC-157](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/recovery-repair/bpc-157): A body protection compound that accelerates tissue repair in tendons, ligaments, muscle, and the GI tract. _$80/15mg_
- [Wolverine Stack](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/recovery-repair/bpc-tb500): The Wolverine Stack: BPC-157 and TB-500 in one vial. Local tissue repair plus systemic recovery in a single foundation healing peptide. _$100/15mg+15mg_
- [KLOW](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/recovery-repair/klow): KLOW: BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, and KPV combined in a single vial. The 4-peptide comprehensive healing stack for tissue repair, recovery, and inflammation control. _$120/15mg+50mg+15mg+15mg_
- [Ondansetron 4mg ODT](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/weight-loss/ondansetron): Anti-nausea adjunct for GLP-1 patients. Generic Zofran orally disintegrating tablets. _$37.50/30 tablets_
- [GHK-Cu 1% Hair Restoration Solution](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/topical/ghk-cu-hair-solution): Compounded 1% GHK-Cu scalp solution. Tripeptide-copper complex for hair restoration and follicular support. _$100/30mL_
- [GHK-Cu SNAP-8 Niacinamide Serum](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/topical/ghk-cu-snap-8-serum): Three-active serum: 3% GHK-Cu for collagen, 1% SNAP-8 for expression lines, 3% niacinamide for barrier repair. Lightweight aqueous vehicle. _$140/30mL_
- [Cashmere Cream (GHK-Cu 3% / Niacinamide 4%)](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/peptides/topical/cashmere-cream): Compounded 3% GHK-Cu and 4% niacinamide daily moisturizer. 30 to 60 times the copper-peptide concentration of OTC serums. _$45/30gm_

## Clinical team

- Medical Director: Dr. Jonathan Snipes, MD (NPI 1821250077). Licensed in 28 states (including the District of Columbia).
- Lead Prescriber: Kim Callender, NP (FNP-BC, NPI 1144661760).
- All scripts are signed by a licensed clinician after individual intake review. No bot prescribing.

## Pharmacy partner

- Optimal Balance Pharmacy, a 503A sterile compounding pharmacy.
- All injectable peptides ship pre-reconstituted and ready to use; no patient reconstitution required. Topical creams, serums, and scalp solutions ship pre-formulated and ready to apply.
- Each batch independently tested by Eagle Analytical Services. Reports are published on the [quality page](https://www.rxpepsdirect.com/quality).
- Shipping: FedEx overnight in a reusable cooled travel case. Syringes and alcohol swabs included with injectables.
